risk_assessment.title: STY-TS-2026 - Men Heavyweight Cotton Crewneck Tee Multi-Section Risk Assessment
risk_assessment.processStep: Fabric Reactive Dyeing & Finishing (Single Jersey 180 GSM)
risk_assessment.potentialFailureMode: Color Bleeding & Wash Crocking Fastness Failure (< Grade 4)
risk_assessment.potentialEffect: Staining of contrast collar rib during washing; buyer lot rejection.
risk_assessment.potentialCauses: Unfixed reactive dye molecules left due to insufficient hot water soaping cycles at textile mill.
risk_assessment.currentControls: Supplier mill test report review only without factory internal cross-check.
risk_assessment.mitigationAction: 100% internal lab multi-fiber wash fastness testing (ISO 105-C06) before roll release to cutting floor.

sectionRisks.processStep: Fabric Reactive Dyeing & Finishing (Single Jersey 180 GSM)
sectionRisks.potentialFailureMode: Color Bleeding & Wash Crocking Fastness Failure (< Grade 4)
sectionRisks.potentialEffect: Staining of contrast collar rib during washing; buyer lot rejection.
sectionRisks.potentialCauses: Unfixed reactive dye molecules left due to insufficient hot water soaping cycles at textile mill.
sectionRisks.currentControls: Supplier mill test report review only without factory internal cross-check.
sectionRisks.mitigationAction: 100% internal lab multi-fiber wash fastness testing (ISO 105-C06) before roll release to cutting floor.

sectionRisks.potentialFailureMode: Screen Print Cracking & Peeling After 5 Domestic Washes
sectionRisks.potentialEffect: Severe customer aesthetic defect; buyer brand degradation and markdown chargeback.
sectionRisks.potentialCauses: Incomplete curing tunnel dwell time (< 2.5 min) or drying temperature under 160°C.
sectionRisks.currentControls: Surface touch check and visual ink opacity inspection only.
sectionRisks.mitigationAction: Hourly thermo-probe oven temperature profiling + 50-times stretch and wash elasticity test.

sectionRisks.processStep: Seam Elasticity & Collar Assembly Tensile Recovery Test
sectionRisks.potentialFailureMode: Neckline Elasticity Loss & Collar Head Opening Out of Spec (>2cm)
sectionRisks.potentialEffect: Garment rejected at AQL final inspection; difficult head opening wearability.
sectionRisks.potentialCauses: Differential feeding tension ratio out of balance; operator pull during circular feeding.
sectionRisks.currentControls: Manual tape measure check on 5 garments per bundle.
sectionRisks.mitigationAction: Install tension-free motorized metering roller on overlock machine + collar circumference jig.

sectionRisks.processStep: Care Label Compliance & Translated Fiber Content Audit
sectionRisks.potentialFailureMode: Incorrect Care Label Symbols, Wrong Fiber % Declaration or Missing RN/CA#
sectionRisks.potentialEffect: Immediate customs seizure at port of entry; heavy administrative fines and mandatory re-labeling penalty.
sectionRisks.potentialCauses: Typographical error in tech pack translation or using wrong label batch across mixed styles.
sectionRisks.currentControls: Operator self-check during label attachment operation.
sectionRisks.mitigationAction: Three-way cross verification protocol: Tech Pack vs. Buyer Care Spec vs. Physical Label Barcode before attachment release.

risk_assessment.notes: 4 section risks evaluated for this style.

risk_assessment.title: Neckline Elasticity & Collar Recovery Evaluation
risk_assessment.potentialFailureMode: Wavy / Stretched Neckline opening after collar overlocking
risk_assessment.potentialEffect: Garment rejected at AQL final inspection; head opening out of spec (>2cm tolerance)
risk_assessment.potentialCauses: Differential feeding tension ratio out of balance; operator pull during circular feeding
risk_assessment.currentControls: Manual tape measure check on 5 garments per bundle (delayed detection)
risk_assessment.mitigationAction: Install tension-free motorized metering roller on 4-thread overlock collar attacher + collar circumference jig.

risk_assessment.title: Metal Contamination & Broken Needle Safety Assessment
risk_assessment.processStep: Denim Heavy Inseam Flat Felling & Metal Detection
risk_assessment.potentialFailureMode: Needle breakage and metal fragment entrapment in heavy seam intersection
risk_assessment.potentialEffect: Critical safety hazard for consumer; failed 9-point conveyor metal detector; legal liability
risk_assessment.potentialCauses: Needle deflection on 14oz denim crossing seam; dull ballpoint needle usage; operator forced pulling
risk_assessment.currentControls: Manual needle change log + magnetic sweep wand
risk_assessment.mitigationAction: Mandatory 100% 9-point conveyor metal detection (calibrated 1.0mm Fe) + broken needle search magnet & lockbox policy.

risk_assessment.title: Waterproof Seam Sealing Tape Peeling & Hydrostatic Leak
risk_assessment.potentialFailureMode: PU Tape delamination under hydrostatic water pressure > 10,000mm

risk_assessment.potentialCauses: Hot air nozzle temperature fluctuation (+/- 15°C); roller pressure uneven across seam crossings
risk_assessment.currentControls: 1 garment per 1,000 pcs hydrostatic Suter head test
risk_assessment.mitigationAction: Deploy digital thermocouple continuous logging + pneumatic pressure sensor calibration twice per shift.

risk_assessment.title: Color Bleeding on Contrast White/Navy Colorblock Garments
risk_assessment.potentialFailureMode: Deep navy reactive dye migrates onto optical white chest band during domestic wash

risk_assessment.potentialCauses: Unfixed hydrolyzed dye residues on reactive navy pique knit; insufficient post-scouring at mill
risk_assessment.currentControls: 40°C wash test on 1 swatch per fabric roll lot
risk_assessment.mitigationAction: Mandate ISO 105-C06 Colorfastness to Domestic Laundering ≥ Grade 4-5 before fabric dispatch + cationic fixative bath.
